findings.summary: Black background with small grey text is hard to read even when enlarged, including the table headers
Too many numbers per row (8 or more) feels overwhelming
No sentence explains which tracks are low risk; reader must infer from 'מניות 0%'
Return column shows 'פחות מ־3 שנים' instead of a return figure, which is unclear
Exposure ring charts use blue and yellow that the reader cannot tell apart
Unknown site name 'מקור' in the top bar; unclear who runs the site
English letters and jargon in track buttons and names
